prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: reusable landscape creator setting for ACP show scene selection.
Scene: a minimalist unoccupied room at night. Muted violet-gray plaster wall, one broad window with gentle rain droplets on the glass, softly out-of-focus city lights outside, a simple low dark console along the side. The central foreground remains open.
Composition: landscape 16:9, eye-level, calm editorial interior photograph using a natural 35mm lens. Intentional clear empty central foreground where a character could later be composited. Balanced broad planes, few objects, moderate depth, no extreme wide-angle distortion.
Lighting: quiet low-light violet-gray ambiance with subtle warm city light reflections, soft believable shadows, periwinkle undertone rather than bright purple; no neon strips.
Materials: matte plaster, rain-speckled real glass, dark warm wood.
Constraints: absolutely no people or human figures, no faces, no mannequins, no text, no signage, no logos, no watermark. No UI chrome, card border, rounded corners, or vignette. Clean simple atmosphere, restrained detail, straight-on eye-level composition. This is a physical environment photograph, not a software screen.
